calls.thesis: Great business trading cheap (P/E 18, 8.3% FCF yield, double-digit EPS growth), but AI-agent disruption risk makes risk/reward unattractive; he explicitly will not take the risk.
calls.price_at_call: No share price stated; down ~24% since August high (28% at one point in video), P/E 18
calls.base_case: Conservative ~13% return: ~12% growth plus 1% dividend, if AI disruption stays limited.
calls.bull_case: AI disruption never materialises; Booking keeps compounding on growing global travel and fee inflation.
calls.bear_case: AI agents take 5-10% of Booking's 10-20% platform fees, squeezing margins; stock could fall another ~50% before disruption is visible, or a recession hits travel.
